entries.title: Unauthenticated command injection on internet-facing mail servers: tracking CVE-2026-73570
entries.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence examines CVE-2026-73570 exploitation in Zimbra, including observed attack paths, detection opportunities, and mitigation guidance.

entries.title: Phishing Abuses RMM Tools for Persistent Access
entries.summary: Microsoft observed phishing campaigns that abused MSP360 RMM to deploy ScreenConnect, creating redundant remote-access channels for follow-on activity

entries.title: ​​Beyond source code: A path to the keys to the kingdom
entries.summary: Explore how Storm-3068 turned a compromised identity into broader cloud access and the steps organizations can take to defend their identities, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.

entries.title: OperTraitors: How Kubernetes Operators Betray Your Security Posture
entries.summary: We introduce OperTraitor, a tool to audit privileges of Kubernetes operators, identify excessive RBAC risks, and secure non-human identities.

entries.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
entries.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.

entries.title: Exploitation of vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway
entries.summary: The NCSC is urging UK organisations to promptly mitigate vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway, two of which are being actively exploited.

entries.title: 3 Consulting Myths Debunked by Unit 42 Experts
entries.summary: Unit 42 security experts address critical cybersecurity misconceptions, offering practical insights to help your organization reinforce its enterprise defenses.

entries.title: U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
entries.summary: A U.S. Army soldier who pleaded guilty to hacking into multiple telecommunications companies and stealing mobile call and text metadata for more than 100 million AT&T customers in 2024 was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison today and ordered to pay nearly $300,000 in restitution to victims.

entries.title: From Exposure to Lockdown: How AWS Neutralizes Compromised IAM Credentials through Managed Policies
entries.summary: We explore how AWS neutralizes exposed IAM credentials using managed policies, detailing GitHub secret scanning and CloudTrail monitoring strategies.

entries.title: A Vault with a Heap-View: The Uncomfortable Space Between AgentCore Harness and Identity
entries.summary: Analysis of how default configurations in AWS AgentCore Harness allow prompt injection to exfiltrate credentials, and key steps to secure your agents.

entries.title: Inside the Modern SOC: Defending the Cross-Environment Pivot
entries.summary: Cross-environment attacks demand a new approach to security operations. Learn how Unit 42 Managed XSIAM helps SOC teams investigate complete attack paths.

entries.title: Data Broker Radaris Loses Domains in Privacy Fight
entries.summary: The consumer data broker Radaris.com has long had a reputation for ignoring requests to remove personal information from its vast empire of people-search services online. entries.title: Atomic macOS (AMOS) Stealer Activity
entries.summary: Modern macOS malware uses deceptive setup guides to steal credentials and sensitive user data. Learn how to identify and block these threats.

entries.title: Iranian cyber targeting of dissidents, activists and journalists

entries.title: Unmasking Cloud Identities: From Behavioral Clustering to Automated Detection
entries.summary: We designed a behavioral clustering model to map cloud identity roles from audit logs, enabling continuous threat detection using standard SQL queries.

entries.summary: Learn how root access on a compromised K8s node allows attackers to utilize SPIFFE/SPIRE metadata to spoof and harvest co-located workload identities.

entries.title: Untracked Nightmares: The Threats Hiding Behind Commodity Infrastructure
entries.summary: An investigation into how cybercriminals used YouTube gaming lures and SEO poisoning to deliver multi-payload malware to enterprise networks.

entries.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
entries.summary: Microsoft Corp. today issued updates to plug at least 974 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, by far its biggest single patch batch ever. entries.summary: A new identity theft service launched on the dark web this week is selling digital scans of more than 153 million drivers licenses from people in the United States and Canada.
